title: 30 days after the apocalypse
description: transforms Minecraft into a post-apocalyptic game full of zombies
body:
### 30 days after the apocalypse
**"30 Days After the Apocalypse" is a zombie apocalypse mod that transforms the game into a post-apocalyptic world filled with zombies.**

![New Zombies](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8a162d24b5f6db498d94c33783395e45c79a5cb4.png)
**It adds various new zombie types, including Ender zombies, fire zombies, tank zombies, and other variants; almost all of them have unique characteristics, though they only appear during the day and during the Blood Moon.**
![New Zombies at night](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4bafd82034ee77a0dd5346921a1d6f5c9cd1f427.png)
**Various new types of zombies also appear at night.**
![New Biomes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d3542280667decbbae8be656623a7b8f6399a36c.png)
**Two new biomes are being added: a wasteland biome and another one that is a desert-style wasteland.**
![lunar events](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/66138421d42212c3846e9268eaf93bd69087789f.png)
**Speaking of lunar events, there will be four new ones: Blood Moon, Blue Moon, Harvest Moon, and Pink Moon. Each has unique features while active.**
![toxic fog](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/651d4137ae09d05d0f23f8dfff4c36732788ae4e.png)
**In the wasteland biome, there will be toxic fog that can appear from time to time; without a hazmat mask, you will take poison damage.**
